info.title: Ride2View HTTP API
info.description: Source-anchored documentation of the current Ride2View Node.js API. This contract is non-invasive: no routes are renamed or version-prefixed. Some payloads remain intentionally opaque until validated against authority schemas. External services are not implicitly activated.

servers.description: Same-origin Ride2View API; production origin configured at deployment

cookieAuth.name: r2v_session
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly SameSite session cookie. Not applicable to public and signed callback operations.

providerSignature.name: x-provider-signature
providerSignature.description: Verified by the configured payment provider adapter. May be unavailable when the provider is not configured.

gatewayHmac.name: x-r2v-signature
gatewayHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 of x-r2v-timestamp + '.' + raw request body; timestamp freshness enforced by server.

OpaqueJsonObject.description: Payload shape is authority-defined. API-01 inventories routes without guessing business fields.

LegacyRegistrationRequest.description: Only available when verified-registration enforcement is disabled. Returns 410 in production.

ManualPaymentVerificationRequest.description: Administrator-only; payment authority validates exact amount, unique references, payable state and reservation confirmation.
